technical.summary: ACN shows solid bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive momentum indicators, but lacks strong crossover confluence and faces volatility compression; moderate swing entry with neutral sector tailwind.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 63 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 purchases) with small amounts from junior members, neutral market sentiment (AAII 44.9% bullish, Fear/Greed 64 = Greed), and no recent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (95.2) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event just occurred; earnings in 63 days provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable for IT sector positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and positive OBV momentum provides solid technical structure for swing entry near support at 301.26.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 95.2, FOMC just occurred) combined with zero fundamental conviction (no insider buying, weak smart money alignment, high earnings risk in 63 days) overwhelms technical bullish setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup is moderate with price above major MAs and positive momentum, but macro environment is severely unfavourable with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels creating headwinds that outweigh entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and VIX at crisis levels (95.2) signal extreme market stress; earnings in 63 days present material downside risk with zero fundamental conviction or insider accumulation.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 17 IT positions with existing ACN exposure; adding to concentration in high-volatility sector during macro crisis is imprudent risk management.
